records.text: Owens said she attended Ye’s Chicago concert the previous week and saw him bring Kid Cudi on stage to perform Ghost Town together after their public falling-out.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: I went to Ye (Kanye West)'s concert last week. You're not going to believe it, but after six years, he returned to Chicago and he did it during the week of your anniversary. ... Ye (Kanye West) and Kid Cudi then had a massive public falling out in 2022. So you have to imagine my shock and surprise when he brought him out on stage to close the show. ... And they sang that exact song. I honestly could not believe it. It all came together. The Wyoming album, one year on ghost town.
